channel.title: Vaibhav Acharya, engineer.
channel.description: Software Engineer at Netlify. I work at the seam where product, design and engineering stop being separate jobs.

item.title: The Internet After Nobody Clicks
item.description: An answer can reach more people while the person who found it loses their audience. What pays for the next answer?

item.title: MCPs, Skills and CLIs
item.description: A teammate asked if Skills replace MCP. They don't, and the CLI half of that argument turned out to be the interesting part.

item.title: HTTP Versions, From 0.9 to 3
item.description: Every HTTP version exists to fix the bottleneck the last one created. The whole arc, briefly.

item.title: QUIC, TCP Rebuilt on UDP
item.description: What you get when you rebuild TCP's reliability on top of UDP in user space, and drop the parts that hurt.

item.title: TCP vs UDP, and When to Reach for Each
item.description: TCP is a reliable byte stream, UDP is fire-and-forget messages. The short version, with Node socket examples.

item.title: The Thing in Between
item.description: We build tools to stay beneath us and children to surpass us. AI is the first thing we have made that sits between the two, and we have not picked a word for it yet.

item.title: What the f**k is a monad again?
item.description: Monads in plain JavaScript: Maybe, map, chain, Promise, and why the weird box thing turns out to be useful.

item.title: Building a Tiny Reactive System
item.description: Signals, effects, and computed values built from scratch in plain JavaScript

item.title: Caching Strategies from Scratch
item.description: LRU, LFU, TTL, write-through, write-back, and cache stampedes explained with interactive demos

item.title: JavaScript Closures and Scope
item.description: The scope chain drawn out, then closures at work as private counters and run-once functions, with the var loop and memory traps.

item.title: Deep Dive into JavaScript Sorting
item.description: Array.prototype.sort explained, custom comparators, and stability quirks

item.title: Deep Dive into JavaScript Array Methods
item.description: Map, forEach, filter, reduce explained from scratch

item.title: Functional Programming in JavaScript
item.description: Pure functions, immutability, higher-order helpers, reduce and composition, ending in a small project that uses all of them.
